positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Directed cross-functional teams in designing and implementing API-based solutions for over 50 external partners, enforcing best practices to streamline Nike’s partner integrations and enhance operational efficiency.
• Architected and delivered scalable integrated solutions, enabling seamless collaboration with high-profile partners (e.g., Meta, Google, Garmin, NBA), supporting effective partner interactions.
• Leveraged generative AI tools and methodologies to consolidate and streamline consumer product data-sharing solutions, improving data accuracy and consistency for partners while significantly reducing the need for manual intervention in resolving data gaps.
• Led technical collaborations with over 20 engineering teams (approx. 250 teammates) to design and deliver low-friction, connected consumer journeys, boosting partner integration success and enhancing customer experiences.
• Contributed key accountability for projects with an annual budget of $5M, ensuring timely delivery, adherence to quality standards, and measurable ROI on strategic initiatives.
• Partnered with legal, privacy, and security teams to develop compliant and secure solutions, balancing regulatory requirements with scalability and functionality to support global operations.
• Developed and maintained comprehensive documentation, enabling efficient onboarding for partners, support engineers, and new teammates, while reducing ramp-up time and improving system adoption.

positions.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
positions.description:
• Streamlined microservice development by authoring reusable project templates and implementing automation, significantly reducing setup friction and improving developer productivity.
• Trained and mentored team members in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) technologies, including Terraform and CloudFormation, while promoting DevOps best practices to enhance team capabilities.
• Played a critical role in bringing Nike’s wholesale site from failed disaster recovery compliance to full compliance, successfully orchestrating the recovery of 47 Tier 1 applications and services.
• Designed and developed applications using Java, Python, React, Redux, Node.js, Spring Framework, MySQL, and Elasticsearch, delivering scalable and high-performing solutions.

positions.title: Business Analyst Intern
positions.description:
• Designed and developed a site for internal project use on Microsoft SharePoint
• Spearheaded initiative to develop an internal taxi application using agile methodology
• Researched and advocated for implementation strategies for a scaled agile framework 
• Built a thorough action plan to recruit volunteers to help get more kids active across the nation

positions.title: ITS Customer Relations Data Analyst
positions.description:
• Analyzed customer feedback to create survey metrics to be reported to upper management
• Improved and conﬁgured datasets to allow for easier data manipulation and analysis
• Managed various types of quantitative and qualitative data

positions.title: Programming Intern
positions.description:
• Developed business applications to generate Excel reports using PHP and PHPExcel
• Designed queries for a database using Laravel to integrate mySQL into PHP
• Created front-end models using HTML and Twitter’s Bootstrap framework for users to interact with the data-
base and choose reports to be generated using speciﬁc input information
• Composed code to update information in the database when certain actions were performed, such as deleting a
transaction
